$comment: P3B-F's own A/B profile (not a scorecard profile: the scorecard is scripts/bench/profiles/p3b.json, P3B-A's). Paths are relative to scripts/bench. Use with -CompareExe <same exe> -CompareEnv '<switch>' (side B gets the switch): SIGIL_VC_FUSION_PARALLEL=0 (the fusion's serial path) on the fusion-* templates, SIGIL_VC_F0_DECODE=1 or SIGIL_VC_F0_GEOMETRY=legacy on the rmvpe-* ones. BUILD=direct: the engine without the voice factory, so the attribution splits onset ticks from steady ones.
name: p3b-f-f0
description: F0 stage cost of P3B-F's switches on DirectML and CUDA: the parallel fusion (target: fusion F0 4.5 -> <= 3.0 ms on DirectML), the cross-tick decoder (< 0.1 ms per tick) and the F0 cache v2 geometry (filled calls).
